name: Bebop Wars
tagline: Hook your opponent across the canal. First to 25 wins.
summary: Hook your opponent across the canal to score. Spend souls on upgrades in the Winter Shop. First to 25 wins.
description: A winter hook arena for 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3. Pull an enemy to your bank to score one capture. First to 25 wins, or lead after eight minutes; ties go to overtime. Start with Hook and 300 Souls, then earn tools and capped Hook upgrades through captures, team income and saves. Death keeps your purchases and returns you to your shop after four seconds.

howToPlay.title: Hook them across
howToPlay.body: Aim across the canal and throw. Pull your opponent onto your side to score.

howToPlay.title: Spend souls
howToPlay.body: Souls come in as you play. Upgrades from the Winter Shop last the whole match.

howToPlay.title: First to 25
howToPlay.body: Each capture is a point. If time runs out, it goes to overtime and the shop closes.

legend.label: Each side has its own Curiosity Shop

facts.label: Arena
facts.value: The canal by the Curiosity Shop

whatsNew: Winter Shop: five upgrades to buy with souls.
Overtime when the clock runs out.

settings.label: Teams
settings.hint: Players per team. Every format has the same shop prices and capture payout.
